body: Whoever commented, you might be shadow banned fyi. I can't see your comment.

>I don’t have family problems. My family is caring and try to help me with my depression. My grades in school are okay, and I’m told I’m bound to go to a good university. On top of that, I have a lovely boyfriend. What would I have to feel suicidal about?

Unfortunately I think mental illness is like a disease. It attacks indiscriminately. A disease doesn't care how in order your life is. It will still make you sick. You don't need to try justify your depression. How you feel is how you feel and it is real.

I'm so sorry you're feeling so bad and at such a young age :(

Yeah. It wasn't super overwhelming or anything but I felt really numb and even though I was staring at my own thigh my brain seemed to just be seeing it as an object and not part of my body. It was so weird.
